# MeshAlive (meshalive.com)
> Enterprise-grade link infrastructure, URL shortener, dynamic QR code engine, and link-in-bio platform with real-time analytics. 100% free forever with unlimited clicks.

## Key Facts
- **Website**: https://meshalive.com
- **Founder**: Vaibhav Pratap Singh (vaibhav@meshalive.com)
- **Pricing**: 100% Free Forever (unlimited links, unlimited clicks, zero subscription fees)
- **Key Features**: Fast redirection (<20ms edge latency), real-time telemetry (geo, device, referrer, UTM), dynamic QR codes (SVG/PNG), custom slugs, developer REST API.
- **Regional Focus**: Global with high-speed edge CDN in North America, Europe, Asia (India / BLR), and South America (Colombia / Bogotá & Medellín).

## Core Tools
- [URL Shortener](https://meshalive.com/tools/url-shortener): Fast, unlimited link shortening with click tracking.
- [QR Code Generator](https://meshalive.com/tools/qr-code-generator): Vector SVG and high-resolution PNG QR codes without expiration.
- [WhatsApp Link Generator](https://meshalive.com/tools/whatsapp-link-generator): Create direct wa.me chat links with pre-filled messages.
- [Link in Bio](https://meshalive.com/tools/link-in-bio): Build a multi-link mobile landing page for Instagram and TikTok.
- [UTM Campaign Builder](https://meshalive.com/tools/utm-builder): Standardized Google Analytics 4 (GA4) campaign tracking.

## Colombia & Latin America Localized Tools (Español)
- [Acortador de URL Colombia](https://meshalive.com/tools/acortador-de-url-colombia): Redirección ultra rápida sub-20ms en operadores Claro, Tigo y Movistar.
- [Crear Link de WhatsApp Colombia (+57)](https://meshalive.com/tools/crear-link-de-whatsapp-colombia): Generador wa.link con prefijo +57 preconfigurado.
- [Generador QR Menú Restaurante](https://meshalive.com/tools/generador-codigo-qr-menu-restaurante-colombia): Códigos QR en alta resolución para cartas y mesas.
- [Link en Bio Colombia](https://meshalive.com/tools/link-en-bio-colombia-gratis): Alternativa a Linktree 100% gratuita.
- [Acortador Links de Pago (Nequi, Bold, Wompi, PSE)](https://meshalive.com/tools/acortador-links-de-pago-colombia): Enlaces de cobro limpios y seguros.
- [Alternativa a Bitly en Colombia](https://meshalive.com/tools/bitly-alternativa-gratis-colombia): Enlaces ilimitados sin pagos en dólares ni límites de 10 links.

## Developer API
- **Endpoint**: `POST https://api.meshalive.com/v1/shorten`
- **Request Body**: `{"url": "https://example.com"}`
- **Response**: `{"short_url": "https://meshalive.com/slug", "slug": "slug"}`
- **Authentication**: Public tier requires no API key; workspace tier available for high-throughput teams.
